subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt five independently configurable memory roles, including per-agent overrides and memoryRole hook metadata, as a supported core/plugin API contract now?
rationale: The patch is not only a refactor: it adds long-lived config keys, migration behavior, hook metadata, and agent-scoped provider routing. The correct permanent role set and external-plugin compatibility commitment require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the role model
options.body: Approve the five-role public contract and require exact-head upgrade and runtime proof before normal merge review resumes.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the initial supported contract to the roles maintainers are willing to document and support, leaving other roles for a follow-up RFC or plugin seam.

options.title: Pause for an API RFC
options.body: Hold this implementation until maintainers define external plugin role ownership, lifecycle context, and deprecation expectations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role model
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role public contract and require exact-head upgrade and runtime proof before normal merge review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes this architecture decision to steipete, although repository-history attribution is not established here.
